Before explaining, check that the wording matches the source. The 1884 year of H1 may be written, but the unknown founder cannot be inferred; making the expression more attractive does not justify adding historical facts.

Visit organisation must put walking, interpretation, question and answer, and the closing limit into the same timetable. Real itinerary or venue changes are confirmed by the responsible person, and personal preference does not replace organisational arrangements.

On receiving closure information, first check the time and the permitted alternative. Only when H2 B confirms at 13:40, before opening, that Q is closed and R is approved and available can the schedule be rearranged as in the prompt; the real situation needs fresh confirmation, and the exercise cannot give permission to reroute in reality.

Check updates, needs and outstanding items with the venue, travel agency, driver and reception colleagues. The duties cooperate with each other, but driving, professional rescue, operations and contract changes are still handled by the people with the corresponding authority.

Working conditions may include indoors and outdoors, constant contact with visitors, walking and standing, and weekends and holidays. The United States OOH describes the combined occupation; the scheduling, pay and labour relationship of a specific Chinese position rest on valid documents.

At the end, hand over visitor questions, material revisions and itinerary changes, marking who confirmed and when it took effect. Public works use only material the person may make public, and visitor lists or unauthorised photos are not added to the practice work.

How do fixed-site interpretation and city tour escorting compare?

Which questions and updates should be handed over at the end?
Material preparation | place and background verification | Check the place's history, environment and confirmed notes, and distinguish known facts, legends and information still to be checked.

Arrangement check | stop and movement time | Combining opening, visitor needs and the confirmed route, recalculate movement, interpretation and question time, keeping the closing limit and the change record.

Interpretation service | interpretation and listening to questions | Introduce points of interest to visitors and respond to questions in clear language; state that unknown content is still to be checked, and do not rely on AI confidence to invent it.

Visit guiding | rules and activity observation | Guide individuals or groups through the visit, explain venue rules, watch for situations affecting service and safety, and feed them back through the process.

Change communication | updates and authority confirmation | On receiving a closure, time slot or organisational change, first check the source and the available alternative, then communicate with the corresponding parties; real changes follow the actual requirements.

Closing maintenance | question and material handover | Keep questions to be checked, confirmed changes and interpretation versions, protect visitor information under the applicable rules, and describe experience honestly.

Explaining to visitors, observing activity, walking between stops and time slot changes need specific assessment; the United States combined environment is only a reference, and Chinese positions are checked against the actual announcement and contract.

Common locations | public buildings, art galleries, historic sites and other places of interest; the opening and transport of different stops are confirmed under valid arrangements, and it cannot be assumed that all are indoors or open all year.

Material and tools | place notes, exhibit labels, visiting rules, routes and timetables, visitor questions and update records are common inputs. Equipment depends on the position's needs, and software or a megaphone is not a universal occupational qualification.

First confirm this route and the material version, then arrange interpretation and question and answer; changes are confirmed by the responsible person, and being able to check minutes on paper does not mean you already have on-site organising ability.

Scheduling and load | part-time, seasonal, weekend, evening and holiday work are common conditions of the United States combined occupation, and walking between stops may continue for a long time; whether preparation and attendance in China are paid still rests on the real organisation and contract.

When coordinating, state the source of the update, its effective time and the questions to be checked; the interpreter does not substitute experience for confirming venue opening or travel agency arrangements.

Review and handover | confirm who revised what, on what basis and when it takes effect, and record the remaining doubts. In a real emergency, report and assist through the organisation's and the relevant agencies' procedures, and the exercise does not provide professional rescue permission.

Service observation | facts, explanation, listening, time slots and rule implementation can be recorded as self-check evidence. Keep the unknown when there is no on-site feedback, and do not declare a single correct paper result to be professional competence.

Insufficient evidence: a precise national occupational wage median or percentile for Chinese tour guides and escorts. The 2025 pre-tax annual average of 79,857 yuan for broad service positions above the designated size is chosen as a broad background only by visitor guiding, interpretation and visiting service tasks, and is not an official occupational equivalence, a tour guide standalone or a personal wage range; self-employed workers and freelancers are excluded. The Chifeng 2025 local tour guide survey and the Guide County historical recruitment are listed separately and do not fill in the national distribution.

Total receipts from self-employment or temporary service, business expenses and personal disposable income are different. The Tourism Law prohibits travel agencies from requiring tour guides to advance or collect fees; uniform commissions, numbers of tours taken or full-year income are not assumed.

There are two checkable Chinese sources: the Chifeng 2025 regional annual wage survey and the Guide County 2026 historical full-time single-position recruitment. The annual distribution and the monthly announcement are explained separately and are not pieced together into a national sample.

The Guide County application closed on 2026-06-23. A 1-month probation pays 2800 yuan per month, and 3500 yuan per month including personal social insurance after passing the assessment; only after a continuous full year with outstanding performance can it reach 4000, and it cannot be written as an automatic pay rise after one year.

Check the actual contract, preparation and attendance, and paid arrangements. A historical quote does not guarantee that a position is still available, and the probation assessment and performance conditions cannot be changed into unconditional fixed treatment.

The 2025 United States national annual wage median for Tour and Travel Guides is 38120 US dollars. The statistical code 39-7010 combines tour guides and escorts with travel guides, and is not the standalone 39-7011.00 wage for this page; P10—P90 both use the national annual wage basis.

The national P10 is 28520 US dollars per year, describing a lower wage position in the statistics. It is not a minimum guarantee for beginners or a statutory minimum wage, and is not directly determined by years of experience.
The national P90 is 60930 US dollars per year. It marks the high percentile threshold, not the highest income, a senior grade or treatment that every tour guide can obtain.

The United States combined 39-7010 occupation had 62200 people employed in 2025 and is projected at 66100 in 2035, growing 6.3% with a net increase of 3900 people; the 11900 average annual job openings include replacement demand, and it cannot be said that 11900 positions are added each year.

OEWS wage statistics exclude self-employment; the employment projection table includes different employment statuses, and the self-employment share of the 2025 combined occupation is 9.2%. The employee wage distribution cannot be used to represent the full-year income of all tour guides.

Published annual statistical values are used directly here.
